goal: Let users discover and install Klyro updates from Settings without visiting GitHub.
proposal: Provide stable and preview update channels from the existing public GitHub repository.

evidence.finding: The repository currently has no published releases.
The Klyro-signed APK artifact is uploaded by CI with 14-day retention; the Klyro signing step is available on the current repository CI.
A successful CI run does not authorize a release or main merge; versionCode is generated from a monotonic workflow run counter.

evidence.source: Android Developers app signing and PackageInstaller docs
evidence.finding: Updates must retain the signing identity; sideloaded installation can require user approval.

direct_check.source: GitHub Releases REST endpoint and current android-build.yml artifacts
direct_check.finding: Stable releases are durable but none exist today; CI artifacts provide a preview source but expire after 14 days.

assumptions.claim: Stable is the default update channel.
assumptions.basis: The user selected the dual-channel option, which was presented as stable by default.

assumptions.claim: Preview follows the branch encoded in the installed CI APK; local builds use main.
assumptions.basis: This maps updates to the code line the user installed without asking for a branch name; validate through CI metadata tests.

assumptions.claim: The in-app flow may download an APK but Android confirms installation.
assumptions.basis: Android PackageInstaller and unknown-source approval behavior.

decision_axes.name: Update source
decision_axes.selected: both channels; stable default and preview selectable

decision_axes.name: Install handoff
considered: Android system installer with explicit approval
decision_axes.selected: Android system installer with explicit approval

alternatives.name: Stable releases only
alternatives.benefit: Durable, named, reviewable APKs and the simplest trust model.
alternatives.risk: Does not expose development builds; no release is currently published.
alternatives.reversal: Add a preview source without changing the stable endpoint.

alternatives.name: Latest CI artifact only
alternatives.benefit: Makes the newest successful development APK available without leaving the app.
alternatives.risk: Artifact expiry, branch ambiguity, and no durable stable channel.
alternatives.reversal: Replace it with a release source; app data and installer stay unchanged.

alternatives.name: Stable and Preview
alternatives.benefit: Covers durable public updates and the user's branch-testing workflow.
alternatives.risk: Adds branch/artifact discovery, expiration and channel-state handling.
alternatives.reversal: Remove Preview while preserving the stable channel and installed app data.

horizons.scenario: The app has no stable GitHub release and development APKs are CI artifacts.
horizons.consequence: Stable shows no release; Preview can find the installed branch's signed CI artifact.

horizons.scenario: Klyro publishes stable releases or changes its distribution provider.
horizons.consequence: Stable keeps a durable update source; Play distribution would require replacing this installer flow.

decision.choice: Implement stable GitHub Releases and branch-aware Preview CI updates in Settings; validate artifacts before presenting the Android installer.
decision.reason: The user selected both channels; the repository has neither stable releases nor a current in-app updater, while the CI already produces Klyro-signed branch APKs.
decision.invalidated_by: Preview artifacts become private/inaccessible or no longer carry the Klyro signing identity; the release channel moves to another distribution platform.
